name: Cheng Heguang
bio: Archetype: Deck Fixing, Extra action, +AP. ⌽ Gain [Work as One] from S2 and Ult: After ally attack, Cheng also attacks the main target, up to a few times per turn. ⌽ For every few actions taken, gain Moxie and grant buffs to the whole team. ⌽ After attacking enough times, the next Ult deals more damage and doesn't cost AP. ⌽ Gain [Lofty Ambitions] from Ult: Converts all Cheng's skills (Including those drawn to hand afterwards and from shuffling) into random ally skills, hand size -2, AP+1.
